Metadata.title: GRIMOIRE - Of Ash and Salt
Metadata.description: GRIMOIRE is an AI-driven narrative roguelike. Explore Velkhar, act freely, roll dice at turning points and leave a mark on a world that remembers.

Landing.heroEyebrow: Solo narrative roguelike · guided by The Blind One, an AI Game Master
Landing.heroBody1: You describe every action. The Blind One improvises what follows, the rules decide and Velkhar remembers.
Landing.heroBody2: Every run becomes a unique story whose consequences endure.
Landing.gameplayBody1: You freely write what your character attempts.
Landing.gameplayBody2: The Blind One narrates the world's response. At decisive moments, a d20 determines success, failure or something in between.
Landing.gameplayBody3: Every result becomes a fact Velkhar may recall later.
Landing.cardActionBody: I reach toward the sealed door.
Landing.cardAnswerBody: Result 12: partial success. The door gives way, but something heard you.
Landing.cardMemoryBody: Later, a witness recognizes you. The open door has become a fact of your story.
Landing.statsCaption: Your three resources. They rise and fall with what you dare.
Landing.worldBody: Velkhar remembers everything. The Blind One improvises each scene from your choices; the rules decide and consequences remain.
Landing.worldPillarMemoryBody: The Blind One remembers every run: your oaths, your betrayals, your deaths.
Landing.worldPillarReplayBody: A journey lasts 45 to 70 minutes during the beta. At the end, your Chronicle. Then you begin again, differently.
Landing.outroBody: A solo game, free during the beta. Give yourself a name and choose a vocation, such as Salt-Walker or Word-Weaver. Then the story begins.

SaltLanding.heroBody: Accept a contract. Cross Velkhar. Return before the world keeps you.
SaltLanding.contractTitle: You don’t pick a level. You accept a quest.
SaltLanding.contractBody: Exploration, escort, investigation or hunt: a contract sets your destination. It does not promise your return.
SaltLanding.contractNote: One main contract. Change it freely at the inn. It locks when you leave.
SaltLanding.playTitle: You act. The Blind One answers. The rules decide.
SaltLanding.playBody: Describe freely what your character attempts. The world reacts, the d20 decides at critical moments, and every consequence becomes a fact.
SaltLanding.passage: The toll keeper is still at his post. Yet everything below his belt is missing. His outstretched hand still demands a coin. Salt has whitened the oldest travellers. Beneath the bridge, something sorts their boots by size. Your contract lies on the other side.
SaltLanding.choice1: Place a tooth in the toll keeper’s hand.
SaltLanding.choice2: Ring the bell with the forearm found beside the cart.
SaltLanding.choice3: Climb down to retrieve the best boots.
SaltLanding.demoResponse: This is an interface preview. Enter the inn for the rules to resolve your action and the Blind One to tell its consequences.
SaltLanding.survivalBody: Drink now or carry the loot. Use an artefact or keep your flesh. Press on or turn back.
SaltLanding.survivalDetail: Combat spends your resources. Outside combat, you can always turn back; the journey home must be played too. Calamine is the price of magic.
SaltLanding.heritageTitle: You will die. Your story won’t.
SaltLanding.heritageBody: Every death ends a character. Your successor inherits neither their face nor their glory: only the artefact passed on, Memories and the traces left behind.
SaltLanding.heritageNote: At its limit, Calamine turns you into a Calcined: this ending passes on no legacy.
SaltLanding.outroBody: Name your next survivor. Choose a calling. The rest will be earned, lost, or eat you.
